selected.assay: bulk total RNA-seq (rRNA-depleted), vastus lateralis, older adults (S2.7.p1)
selected.primary_estimand: Within-participant change in muscle gene expression with 5 d bed rest (disuse; POST vs PRE) and after 7 d re-ambulation (REC vs PRE), separately in the placebo and metformin arms (S3.4.p1, Fig 5a-d). Physical-activity axis = disuse/reloading, not structured exercise.
selected.repeated_measure_unit: participant (biopsies at PRE, DAY1, POST, REC; S2.4.p1)
selected.inclusion: fasted biopsies at PRE, POST, REC; N = 9-10/group (Fig 5 legend)
planned_contrasts: Placebo POST vs PRE (S3.4.p1; paper 441 DEGs)
selected.paper_method: DESeq2 1.30 via hciR (S2.7.p1); formula not stated
selected.paper_results: collagen isoforms highly upregulated in placebo REC (S3.4.p1); CDKN1A, TP53 up in placebo not metformin after bed rest and recovery (S3.5.p1)

decisions.reason: S2.7.p1 gives DESeq2 + 5% FDR, no fold-change rule; S3.4.p1 gives the four within-arm DEG counts vs PRE. The paper's activity manipulation is bed-rest disuse followed by re-ambulation; there is no exercise-training arm, so the activity estimand is disuse/reloading within each arm.

checks: timepoint labels PRE/Day1/POST/7d and Placebo/Metformin match the trial design (S2.3.p1)
10 metformin participants (5F/5M = Table 1) and 9 placebo (paper N=9-10/group)

decisions.reason: Both count files (19565R, 20063R sequencing runs) belong to GSE224900 and the paper names it.

selected.subject_key: derived in prep_merge.py from consecutive per-participant biopsy blocks; age/sex/treatment constant within each block

decisions.reason: Matrix columns (19565X1...) equal the first token of title, written as column `key` by prep_merge.py (two count files merged on identical Ensembl IDs). GEO has no participant ID; prep_merge.py assigns `subject` by sample-number blocks that each start at a PREbc biopsy - every block has one age, one sex and one treatment, giving 9 placebo + 10 metformin participants. Clamp (ac) and Day1 biopsies excluded: the paper's DE uses fasted PRE/POST/REC.

candidates: raw_counts (confirm against provenance: normalized integers and rounded estimated counts look the same)

decisions.reason: All values integer, median 0, max ~1.2e7; data_processing: STAR two-pass alignment to GRCh38/Ensembl 104 with gene counts; paper used DESeq2.

selected.estimand_type: within-subject change; no non-bed-rest control arm

decisions.reason: Placebo arm isolates disuse/re-ambulation (primary); metformin arm reproduces the paper's second set but mixes drug exposure with disuse (secondary). Each arm fitted separately as the paper reports per-arm volcano plots.

caveats: Activity axis is bed-rest disuse and re-ambulation, not exercise training.
No time-matched non-bed-rest control: time contrasts include any time/season effect; metformin-arm contrasts also include drug exposure (POST) or withdrawal (REC).
Participant IDs were derived from sample-number blocks, not given in GEO.

Expression-inferred sex contradicts GEO labels in 7 metformin-arm biopsies: 5 biopsies excluded, one block relabelled F; the metformin arm therefore differs from the paper's sample set (paper presumably used the labels as deposited).

decisions.reason: All four contrasts follow the paper's DESeq2 + FDR 5% route.
